claim_text: The transmission spectrum of GJ 1214b is featureless, which rules out cloud-free high-mean-molecular-weight atmospheres and requires high-altitude clouds.
supporting_evidence: 15 HST/WFC3 transit observations combined into a 1.1-1.7 micron transmission spectrum with sub-30 ppm precision.
assumptions: stellar activity does not mimic a flat spectrum
uncertainty: Cloud-free water-dominated atmosphere ruled out at 16.1 sigma.

claim_text: The diversity of water absorption amplitudes across ten hot Jupiters is caused by clouds and hazes, not by primordial water depletion.
supporting_evidence: Correlation between the H2O amplitude and the blueward optical scattering slope across the sample.
assumptions: sample of ten planets is representative of hot Jupiters
haze scattering follows the assumed power law
uncertainty: Trend established across the sample; individual-planet metallicities remain degenerate with cloud-top pressure.
